text:
alex: Heads up - Heliogen noticed a $9,412.50 overage on INV-2026-5122. Claim: spike tied to our end-of-period metering batch on 2026-07-31.
rhea: I pulled the meter pipeline. Vendor (ThirdWaveMeter) shipped a late batch for 07-31 that retroactively applied burst units into the July invoice during finalization.
carla-finance: late batch -> billing across cutoff? That can push charges into the wrong period, messy for customers. How many units are we talking?
marco-ops: sample from the late batch: 
```
2026-07-31T23:58:12Z,Heliogen,eu-west,TWM-BURST,31234
2026-07-31T23:58:12Z,Heliogen,eu-west,TWM-BURST,31234
```
marco-ops: looks like dedup failed AND the batch replayed into finalized billing. Net effect = ~62k extra units.
carla-finance: at burst rate $0.1515/unit that maps to $9,393. So matches customer's $9,412.50 after taxes/fees.
vendor-support: we opened ticket TWM-7712; vendor says their late aggregator retried writes after timeout and replayed batches. They accept responsibility and offered reimbursement.
carla-finance: propose provisional credit equal to the invoice overage so customer isn't charged while vendor reimbursement is processed. We'll tag as VendorRecovery/TWM-7712 and set 14-day recovery window.
alex: customer wants the credit posted before they issue their internal chargeback. They also requested a note explaining the cause. Keep it short.
carla-finance: accounting memo (provisional): DR Revenue Adjustment 6102 $9,412.50 / CR Accounts Receivable 1200 $9,412.50. Use memo: "Vendor replayed late batch into finalized invoice; provisional credit pending vendor reimbursement."
marco-ops: ops will add a cutover check to prevent late-batch writes after billing finalization and add a dedup check keyed by batch_id + event_id.
vendor-support: vendor ETA for reimbursement docs: 5 business days. They provided a statement and will issue a credit to our vendor portal.
carla-finance: approvals please: @carla-finance, @marco-ops, @rhea react :thumbsup: to proceed with provisional credit.
carla-finance: (reacts) :thumbsup:
marco-ops: (reacts) :thumbsup:
rhea: (reacts) :thumbsup:
alex: I'll send the customer note and attach the provisional credit. permalink: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01FINANCE/p1845554321000456
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-5122 status -> ADJUSTED (credit $9,412.50) / VendorTicket: TWM-7712
carla-finance: leaving thread open until vendor reimbursement posts and AR reversal confirmed.
